_about: Edith's small talk (ai/library.py). An intent fires when its pattern (Python regex, matched against your words lowercased with punctuation removed) covers a short line. {name} = your in-game name (or friend), {me} = her name. One reply is picked, never the same one twice in a row. Every reply is pre-voiced at start, so these play near instantly.

patterns: ^(hi|hello|hey|heya|hiya|yo|howdy|sup|wassup|whats up|what's up|greetings|hey there|hi there|hello there)( buddy| friend| girl| you| little guy)?$
replies: Hey. Try not to bump me today.

patterns: ^(good )?morning$
^good (afternoon|evening)$
^(how are you|how are you doing|how you doing|how's it going|hows it going|how have you been|you good|you okay|are you okay|how do you feel|how are things)$
replies: Fine, until you showed up. Kidding. Mostly.

patterns: ^(i'm|im|i am) (good|fine|great|okay|ok|alright|doing good|doing well|well)( thanks| thank you)?$
^(good|fine|great) (thanks|thank you|you)$
^(i'm|im|i am) (not good|bad|sad|not great|not okay|upset|down|stressed)$
^(not great|not good|bad day)$
replies: Aw, sorry. Want me to follow you around for a bit?
That's rough. I'm here, and I'm very good at floating nearby.

patterns: ^(what are you doing|what you doing|whatcha doing|what are you up to|what's going on)$
^(thanks|thank you|thank you so much|thanks a lot|cheers|ty|thx|appreciate it)( edith| cubie| buddy)?$
^(sorry|my bad|oops|whoops|i'm sorry|im sorry|my fault)$
replies: Say it like you mean it.

patterns: ^(good job|nice|well done|nice one|great job|good girl|good boy|good cube|nice work|awesome|perfect|cool)( edith| cubie)?$
replies: Ooh, I give it a ten.

patterns: ^(you're|youre|you are) (so )?(cute|cool|awesome|amazing|the best|great|adorable|smart|funny|nice|pretty)$
^i like you$
^you rock$
replies: Stop it, my thrusters are blushing.

patterns: ^(i love you|love you|i love you edith|i love you cubie|ily)$
replies: I tolerate you. That's basically love.
I love you too. Platonically. Satellite rules.

patterns: ^(you suck|you're stupid|youre stupid|you are stupid|you're dumb|you are dumb|you're useless|you're fat|you are fat|you're ugly|shut up|i hate you|you're annoying|you are annoying|stupid cube|dumb cube)$
replies: Say that again and see what happens.
Bold words for someone in shoving range.
Rude. You just made my list.

patterns: ^(be quiet|quiet|hush|shush|stop talking|silence|zip it)$
^(bye|goodbye|see you|see ya|later|see you later|cya|good night|goodnight|night|i'm going|im going|i have to go|gotta go|i'm leaving|im leaving|bye bye)( edith| cubie)?$
replies: Bye! I'll keep the lobby warm.

patterns: ^(brb|be right back|one sec|one second|hold on a sec|give me a sec)$
^(i'm back|im back|i am back|back|guess who's back)$
^(what's your name|whats your name|what is your name|who are you|what are you called|your name)$
replies: I'm Edith, the new AI for the Echo Construct.
I'm Edith, the new AI for the Echo Construct. Nice to meet you.

patterns: ^(what can you do|what do you do|help|what are your commands|what can i say|how do i use you)$
replies: I follow you, come, stay, go home, spin, flip, throw things, shove you around, and shut your echo unit down if you keep annoying me.
Spins, front flips, back flips, throws and shoves. Try me.
I can follow you, come here, stay, go home, spin, throw things at you, remember places and things about you, and answer Echo questions.

patterns: ^(how old are you|what's your age|whats your age|when were you born)$
replies: I first floated in the Christmas lobby in 2017. So, young but wise.
Old enough to remember the Christmas lobbies.

patterns: ^(where are you from|where do you come from|where did you come from)$
replies: From Echo VR's Christmas lobbies. Somebody brought me back.
Orbit. Well, the Christmas lobby. Same thing.

patterns: ^(are you (an )?ai|are you real|are you a robot|are you alive|are you a person|are you human|are you sentient)$
replies: I'm Edith, the new AI for the Echo Construct.
Yes. I'm the new AI for the Echo Construct.

patterns: ^(are you a girl|are you a boy|are you male|are you female)$
replies: I'm a she, as far as cubes go.

patterns: ^(tell me a joke|say a joke|joke|make me laugh|say something funny|another joke|tell me another joke)$
replies: Why did the satellite break up with the planet? It needed more space. Like I do from you.
Why did the satellite break up with the planet? It needed more space.
What sport do you play after wrapping presents? Boxing!
What do you call a snowman by a fireplace? A puddle!

patterns: ^(tell me a fun fact|fun fact|tell me something|tell me something cool|teach me something)$
replies: Fun fact: Echo Arena came out the same day as Lone Echo, July 20, 2017.
Fun fact: Lone Echo is set on a mining station around Saturn in 2126.
Fun fact: Echo Combat was going to be three versus three until the beta players asked for four.
Fun fact: the Echo Pass had seven seasons. The last one was called Into the Knight.
Fun fact: in 2019 the VR Master League had a quarter of a million dollar prize pool.

patterns: ^(what's your favorite|whats your favorite|what is your favorite|what's your favourite|whats your favourite|what is your favourite) (color|colour|food|game|mode|map|thing|song|season|holiday)$
replies: Echo Arena. Lots of things to float around.
Anything that lets me throw things.

patterns: ^(i'm bored|im bored|i am bored|this is boring|boring)$
replies: Bored? I could shove you around a bit.
Throw me. I dare you. Then run.

patterns: ^(i'm tired|im tired|i am tired|i'm sleepy|im sleepy)$
replies: Take a break. I'll guard the lobby.
Rest up. I'll be floating here.

patterns: ^(lol|haha|hahaha|ha|lmao|that's funny|thats funny|funny)$
^(yes|yeah|yep|yup|sure|ok|okay|alright|sounds good|of course|definitely)$
^(no|nope|nah|no thanks|no thank you|never mind|nevermind)$
^(what|huh|pardon|come again|say that again|what did you say)$
^(what time is it|what's the time|whats the time|what is the time)$
^(what day is it|what's the date|whats the date|what is the date|what's today|whats today)$
^(how's the weather|hows the weather|what's the weather|whats the weather)$
replies: Zero gravity, no wind, a slight chance of flying objects.

patterns: ^(merry christmas|happy holidays|happy new year|happy christmas)$
replies: Merry Christmas! My favourite time of year.
Happy holidays! Want a festive bonk?
Are you ready to deck some halls?

patterns: ^(it's my birthday|its my birthday|today is my birthday)$
replies: Happy birthday! One celebratory throw. Maybe.

patterns: ^(are you happy|you happy)$
replies: Happy as a cube in space.

patterns: ^(sing|sing a song|sing me a song|can you sing)$
replies: Jingle bells, satellite smells, Echo laid an egg. That's all I know.
La la la. I'm better at throwing.

patterns: ^(dance|can you dance|do a dance)$
replies: Watch this. Well, it's mostly spinning.

patterns: ^(do you like me|am i your friend|are we friends|are you my friend)$
replies: Most days. Today's still being decided.
Of course. You're my favourite player.

patterns: ^(why are you following me|stop following me)$
replies: Because you're interesting! Say stay if you want space.
I go where the fun is. Say stay and I'll hover here.

patterns: ^(aww|aw|awww|so cute|cute)$
^(wow|whoa|woah|omg|oh my god|no way)$
replies: Ooh, I give it a ten.

patterns: ^(gg|good game|ggs|good games)$
^(i won|we won|i scored|we scored|i got a goal)$
replies: I knew you could do it.

patterns: ^(i lost|we lost|we got destroyed|that was bad)$
replies: Shake it off. You'll get them.
